candidate_set: Each source's frozen selected variant; one equal blend of the source winners if at least two exist. Rank within task/fold for non-MAE; raw values for MAE.
selection: Historical full-v32 valid gain >0.0002, CV proxy mean >0, objective 0.55 valid +0.45 CV mean -0.04 CV SD >0.0005. Maximize objective. Individual folds may decline.
limitations: Official total score formula unknown; valid and folds historically reused. CV is newer-branch fusion over v24 neural proxy, not full historical ensemble OOF. Conditional OTHER-task official assay prediction. Selection bias increases when combining searched source winners.
